description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for language theming, including theme registration, preprocessing functions for language negotiation forms, content settings tables, and block templates.

classes.name: LanguageThemeHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks related to language theming, including theme registration and preprocessing for language negotiation forms, content settings, and blocks.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Registers theme hooks for language negotiation configuration form and language content settings table.

methods.name: preprocessLanguageNegotiationConfigureForm
methods.description: Prepares variables for rendering the language negotiation configuration form, building a table of detection methods.

methods.name: preprocessLanguageContentSettingsTable
methods.description: Prepares variables for rendering the language content settings table, organizing bundle settings into a table.

methods.name: preprocessBlock
methods.description: Preprocesses block templates, adding role attribute if provider is 'language'.
